channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Pending notice: Michael David Hansen
item.description: Michael David Hansen , age 74, of Hayward, Minnesota, passed away on Monday, February 2, 2026, at Banner – University Medical Center Phoenix in Phoenix, Arizona. Services are pending. Worlein-Hoff Funeral Homes of Austin are assisting the family with arrangements.

item.title: Broken sprinkler head forces early release of Banfield Elementary Thursday, move to remote learning Friday
item.description: Broken sprinkler at Banfield Elementary triggers early dismissal Thursday; school shifts to remote Friday as repairs continue, Oakland Education Center closed.

item.title: Austin HRA awarded funding toinstall solar systems at Chauncey, Courtyard Apartments
item.description: Austin HRA secures state and federal funding to install twin 40 kWh solar systems at Chauncey and Courtyard Apartments, cutting common-area power costs and funding future upgrades.

item.title: Cast your votes to help MnDOT name eight more snowplows statewide
item.description: Help MnDOT name eight new snowplows: see the 30 finalists and cast your one-time vote for up to eight favorites by noon Feb. 13 at mndot.gov/nameasnowplow.

item.title: Senior surge: Hebrink and Omot guide Packers to monstrous home win over Tigers
item.description: Seniors Cole Hebrink and Banyaan Omot power Austin past Stewartville 75-70, boosting the Packers' hopes for a No. 2 seed in the upcoming Section 1AAA Tournament.

item.title: Lyle-Pacelli boys fall to Burros
item.description: Lyle-Pacelli boys fall 73-51 to Lanesboro; Hunter Wollenberg scores 15 in home loss as LP drops to 7-13 overall against the 16-3 Burros

item.title: Burros take down Viking girls in Lanesboro
item.description: Jensyn Storhoff's 32 points power Lanesboro Burros past Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy 74-67, despite 23 from Maggie Hansen in girls basketball matchup.

item.title: Blossoms bring down WEM boys basketball team
item.description: Wyatt Rafdal scores 21 as Blooming Prairie tops Waterville-Elysian-Morristown 73-56, improving to 15-6 while WEM falls to 7-12.

item.title: Matheis scores 23 as Rebels take down Hurricanes
item.description: Juliette Matheis poured in 23 points as Southland rolled past Houston 73-50, improving to 17-3 in girls basketball action Thursday.

item.title: Blossom girls use second half effort to beat Grand Meadow
item.description: Blooming Prairie girls pull away after halftime to beat Grand Meadow 69-45, as Ella Salinas scores 16 points and Claire Schwarz adds 15.
